title: A Compilation of Robots Falling Down at the DARPA Robotics Challenge
summary: An IEEE Spectrum compilation of humanoid robots falling over during the 2015 DARPA Robotics Challenge Finals.
why: HN uses it as the go-to illustration of Moravec's paradox and as a baseline for how far robotics has come since 2015.

quote.text: One of my favourite videos is this compilation of robots falling (failing) during the simplest tasks at the 2015 DARPA challenge
